item.title: Auditors Refuse To Sign Off Council Accounts For Second Year
item.description: Financial concerns continue at Harborough District Council after external auditors declined to sign off its accounts for the second year running. A disclaimer of opinion has again been issued, meaning auditors cannot confirm that the 2024/25 financial statements are accurate. item.title: County Council Abandons Plans to Close SEND Nurseries
item.description: Leicestershire County Council has abandoned plans to close nurseries for children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) following widespread opposition. The proposal had suggested moving SEND provision into mainstream nurseries, but parents raised concerns that their children would not receive the support they need. item.title: Hundreds Back Rewilding Project After Funding Axed
